slug: 2026-06-11 Can Africa supply it's own digital infrastructure

facts.fact: Data Landscapers' June 2026 register of carrier-neutral African data centres states that Paratus runs five data centres across Angola, Namibia and Zambia, so it has one or more in Zambia; the facility is not named and the opening date is not given (published date used).

note: One weak service fact: Zambian facility unnamed, Zambia only in the 'five centres across Angola, Namibia and Zambia' line; no tier or cloud region for ZMB.
